visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair sits at a wooden table covered with a checkered tablecloth. To her left is a young girl in a pink tracksuit, and to her right is a young boy in a red sweater. Behind them is a white wall with a large red snake drawing and some toy shelves. They each have a lidded container in front of them. (2) The woman reaches for her container and opens it, revealing an empty plate underneath. The children look at her curiously. (3) The young girl picks up a strawberry from her own plate and offers it to the woman. The woman smiles and takes it. (4) The young boy then holds out a snack from his plate towards the woman, mirroring his sister's gesture. The woman looks touched and takes both snacks. (5) The woman holds the snacks in her hands and breaks one in half, handing the pieces back to the children so they can all eat together. (6) Both children lean in to hug and kiss the woman on the cheeks simultaneously. The woman laughs and embraces them warmly, appearing happy and emotional.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a 'sharing experiment' where a mother tests her children's willingness to share their food when her own plate is empty. The purpose is to capture and showcase the children's spontaneous kindness and affection, appealing to an audience interested in parenting and heartwarming family content.
